info.title: ClubAdmin API
info.description: REST API of ClubAdmin. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json).

bearer.description: Access token from the identity provider. Send the ID token issued with it in `X-Id-Token` (ADR 0024).

get.summary: Plans and add-ons with what they grant (operators)
get.description: Requires permission `billing.plans.read` on the platform. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: A club the caller is related to, with its managers
get.description: Requires permission `club.read` on the club. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

put.summary: Set the club's access state (operators): read_only refuses changes, suspended everything but exports; nothing is deleted
put.description: Requires permission `club.access_state.update` on the club. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: What the club may use (features and limits), its plan and access state
get.description: Requires permission `club.read` on the club. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: The club's groups by name (archived ones for managers and registrars)
get.description: Requires permission `club.read` on the club. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: The club's subscription (club managers, treasurers, operators)
get.description: Requires permission `billing.subscription.read` on the club. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

put.summary: Put the club on a plan with add-ons (operators)
put.description: Requires permission `billing.subscription.manage` on the club. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

put.summary: Change the subscription status (operators); read_only makes the club read-only, nothing is deleted
put.description: Requires permission `billing.subscription.manage` on the club. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: A group with its owners (people the caller may not see are left out)
get.description: Requires permission `group.read` on the group. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: The group's members by name, with their functions
get.description: Requires permission `group.members.read` on the group. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: The logged-in person (creates the account on the first login)
My clubs (or my ward's, with X-On-Behalf-Of): membership and roles
My groups and my wards' groups, with functions (the ward's own with X-On-Behalf-Of)

patch.summary: Change my language, time zone or theme

get.summary: Security overview; needs a login with a second factor
My browser sessions

delete.summary: Revoke one of my sessions (logs that browser out)

get.summary: The people I am a guardian of, with my rights
Supported app versions, feature flags and server capabilities (ADR 0029)
Where to get the source code of the running version (AGPL-3.0 section 13)
Running version
Last successful backups and restore verification, with warnings when they are too old (operators)
get.description: Requires permission `ops.backup.read` on the platform. Answers 404 when the caller has no relationship with the resource's club (or it is a person they may not see), 403 otherwise.
